clips.title: The story
paras: Uthek the Wise says meat gives the Gelkis their strength, and that the Magram keep extra stores so they can fight longer between hunts. You are sent to raid the Magram village to the east and bring back six bags of dried meat.

Between wars the Gelkis hunt, because meat means strength and a full belly fights harder than an empty one. Uthek the Wise says the Magram keep spare stock to last them between hunts. Raid their village to the east, take those stores, and their strength will fail. Six bags of crudely dried meat are wanted, to be brought to Uthek at the Gelkis Village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When we are not at war, we hunt for meat. Meat gives us strength, and full bellies fight harder than empty ones.
It is the same with the Magram. They store extra meat so they may fight longer between hunts. If you raid their village to the east and take their stores of meat, then their strength will fail.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Return after you further prove your worth to the Gelkis!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good. I can hear the loud Magram bellies grumble from their village, far away!
I will give this meat to the Gelkis. And we will fight for many days without rest.
What you did is good for the Gelkis, friend.
